nodes.name: NiFe NNG Synthesis (10 mg GO)
nodes.procedure: Graphene oxide (GO, 10 mg) is dispersed in water with sonication assistance. Ni and Fe precursors (Ni(NO₃)₂·6H₂O and Fe(NO₃)₃·9H₂O) in 2:1 mole ratio are dissolved in GO-dispersed solution with vigorous stirring for ≈5 min at room temperature. Freshly prepared NaBH₄ solution is quickly injected. Mixture stirred for 5 min to collect black solids via centrifugation, followed by freeze-drying.

nodes.source_text: LSV curves before and after 2000 potential cycles test in 1 M KOH aqueous solution... shows a slight positive shift of overpotential at 10 mA cm⁻².

nodes.source_text: EIS measurements were conducted at 1.5 V (V vs RHE)... NiFe NNG-20 exhibits the lowest R_ct (8.38 Ω).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images show NiFe nanoparticles forming dense distribution on graphene for NiFe NNG-10 and NNG-20 (Figure 1b-d); inset shows isolated NiFe nanoparticles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The distribution of NiFe on graphene was investigated using transmission electron microscopy (TEM) in Figure 1b-d.

properties.description: High-resolution TEM image showing lattice fringes
Inset showing selected area with lattice planes
Fast Fourier Transform pattern labeled with (Fe,Ni)

nodes.characterization_summary: Low and high magnification STEM images of NiFe NNG-20 show NiFe nanoparticles anchored on graphene surface; inset SAED pattern confirms crystal structure (Figure 2a-b).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The morphology of NiFe NNG-20 was further characterized by scanning TEM (STEM) images (Figure 2a)... the selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern in the inset shows the crystal structure...

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS mapping confirms uniform distribution of Fe and Ni on NiFe NNG-20 hybrids.
nodes.evidence_snippet: STEM energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) elemental mapping further confirms the uniform distribution of Fe and Ni on the hybrids, as shown in Figure 2c...

properties.description: Four-quadrant elemental distribution map labeled C, O, Fe, Ni

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of NiFe NNG-10, NNG-20, and NNG-30 show characteristic peaks of face-centered cubic Ni-Fe alloy at 43.4°, 50.9°, 74.5° (111), (200), (220) facets, plus peaks for Fe2O3, NiO, NiFe2O4, and FeNi2O4 phases.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) was employed to measure and reveal the crystal structure of NiFe NNG-10, NiFe NNG-20, and NiFe NNG-30. These three composite materials showed similar characteristic peaks (Figure 2d).

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM of NiFe NNG-20 shows lattice spacings of 0.146 nm (NiFe 121), 0.251 nm (NiFe 110), plus Fe2O3, NiO, NiFe2O4 phases consistent with XRD.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In addition, the microstructures of the NiFe NNG-20 were investigated by bright field STEM (BF-STEM) imaging... lattice spacings of 0.146 and 0.251 nm should be assigned to the NiFe (121) and (110) moieties...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES of NiFe NNG-20 shows oxidation state >+2 (higher than NiO); Fe K-edge between FeO and Fe2O3 (average +2 to +3). Post-OER shows increased oxidation (Figure 3a-b,5a,c).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra show that the absorption edge position of NiFe NNG-20 in the Ni K-edge is higher than that of NiO...

visual_evidence.name: NiFe NNG-20 after ADTT Fe K-edge spectrum

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS survey shows Ni 4.10 at.%, Fe 9.08 at.% (Ni:Fe ≈1:2.21); Ni 2p: Ni²⁺ (855.2, 872.9 eV), Ni³⁺ (856.9, 874.7 eV); Fe 2p confirms +2/+3 states; O 1s: 530.6 eV (M-O), 534.8 eV (C-O-C) (Figure 3c-f).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface composition of NiFe NNG-20 was further analyzed by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS)... The results indicated that the atomic ratio of Ni (4.10 at.%) to Fe (9.08 at.%)...

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman shows D, G, 2D bands at 1347, 1578, 2709 cm⁻¹; NiFe NNG-20 has highest ID/IG ratio indicating most defects.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman spectrum of NiFe NNG-10, NiFe NNG-20 and NiFe NNG-30 (Figure 3g) display the D, G and 2D bands at 1347, 1578, and 2709 cm⁻¹...

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe NNG-20 has highest BET surface area of 57.83 m²/g; total pore volumes: NNG-10 0.0583, NNG-20 0.1241, NNG-30 0.1486 cm³/g; mesoporous nature.
nodes.evidence_snippet: NiFe NNG-20 possesses the highest specific Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) surface area (57.83 m² g⁻¹) among the three electrocatalytic materials.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRF shows NiFe NNG-20 composition Ni 29.55%, Fe 70.45% (Ni:Fe ≈1:2.38); post-stability Fe decreases to 62.79%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: This ratio closely aligns with the 1:2.38 ratio obtained from X-ray fluorescence (XRF) analysis, which reported Ni at 29.55% and Fe at 70.45% (refer to Figure S3a).
